description: This file defines a CMake macro called 'CreateDepPackage' used for creating Debian package dependencies (DEP packages). It processes input arguments, sets up package metadata, and configures CPack for packaging, handling components, versioning, maintainer info, and other package details.

methods.name: CreateDepPackage
methods.description: Macro to set up and generate a DEP package with specific components, version, maintainer, and other metadata.
